baseline_qwen.rationale: The image shows multiple, well-circumscribed, keratotic papules with a warty appearance, which is characteristic of Darier-White Disease. The presence of hyperkeratotic lesions and the typical clinical presentation support this diagnosis.
baseline_qwen.follow_up_considerations: Further clinical examination and possibly a biopsy may be necessary to confirm the diagnosis and rule out other differential diagnoses.
